summary: Form-associated calendar date field that reuses Input density, focus, validation, and field composition with a native date value.
useWhen: A user must enter or edit a calendar date as an ISO date string.
The date must participate in native, Angular, React, or Vue form state.
The control should match Input geometry, typography, and field composition rather than a one-off native date input.
avoidWhen: The value is freeform text, a number, or a search query.
The value is a clock time without a calendar date.
The user chooses a predefined relative range such as last 7 days.

alternatives.when: The value is one line of text, email, search, or an exact number.
alternatives.reason: Input owns those native types, adornments, search clearing, and numeric stepping.

alternatives.when: The value is a clock time.
alternatives.reason: InputTime owns native time semantics and the clock picker affordance.

alternatives.when: The user chooses a relative or bounded date range from presets.
alternatives.reason: TableFilter owns relative date presets and range selection rather than a single calendar date.

accessibility: Provide a persistent visible label through the owning field or an external native label.
The native date input remains the keyboard and assistive-technology control; the calendar icon only opens the browser picker and is hidden from the accessibility tree.
Filled values keep YYYY-MM-DD as the native and form value. Visible text uses a short-month calendar label such as Sep 10, 2026 so the field does not show ISO chrome.
Error text is associated with the native input and announced as an alert when the invalid state is rendered.
Read-only fields remain focusable and submittable while preventing edits; inactive or disabled fields leave the tab order and are omitted from form submission.
states: Every size applies the shared control-density recipe, including md body-medium text, across frame height, inline padding, icon zones, and radius.

The normal field boundary uses the shared secondary inset border. Focus promotes it to the thicker bold-brand inset stroke, while error uses the thicker bold-negative inset stroke without changing geometry.
The host exposes focused, filled, dirty, touched, invalid, disabled, read-only, and required data attributes for Field integration and diagnostics.
The trailing calendar action is a pointer affordance; it does not replace the field label or the native date value.
A filled field paints the readable calendar label over the native date text. Empty fields keep the browser empty-date chrome.
responsiveBehavior: Form fields normally fill their parent; use hug width only in a compact toolbar or filter layout with an explicit width constraint.
Choose density from the containing layout: md for ordinary forms, lg for a touch-primary layout, and sm or xs only where surrounding controls use the same compact recipe.

customElements: Listen for dsChange for user edits. The detail is the native date string, typically YYYY-MM-DD.
Use the form attribute on the host when associating a date field rendered outside its owning form.
react: Use DsInputDate, bind value for controlled application state, and handle onDsChange.
vue: Use DsInputDate with v-model for the value, and listen for dsChange.
angular: Import DsInputDate with TextValueAccessor when integrating with Angular Forms.
